title: Veloso camp expects Mary Jane’s release soon after Marcos’ absolute pardon
summary: The legal team of Mary Jane Veloso expects her release soon after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. granted her an absolute pardon on Friday, although the necessary procedures still have to be completed.
